name: Finish the structural Pack→pixel contract
description:
## Goal
Make structural Pack Roles (edge/depth/light/material) reach pixels so multi-pack re-skin is real beyond color+font. North-star core.

## Why
resolveAppearanceVars color-filters output today, so structural Roles are declared+boot-validated but inert; resolveStyle/resolveRole have zero callers. See docs/engine-architecture.md § Appearance + docs/roadmap.md.

## Done when
A structural Role change in a manifest visibly changes the render; the dead resolveStyle/resolveRole path is removed; editorial-mono re-skins a real deliverable structurally.

name: Prove-or-remove the 4 dead-by-use pipelines
description: isolate (annotation), watermark + shader-fill (overlays), chromatic-aberration (effect) are registered + boot-valid but referenced by zero presets. Each gets a proving fixture/deliverable OR full removal. box/strike explicitly retained, not in scope.

name: Wire structural Role resolution to pixels
description: Extend the Pack->pixel path so edge/depth/light/material Roles affect the render (resolveAppearanceVars color-filters them out today). Decide: extend resolveAppearanceVars with structural handling, or a dedicated resolver consumed by pipelines/shaderPasses. Done when a manifest edge/depth change is visible on canvas.
result: Wired the structural depth Role to pixels via a dedicated resolveDepthTreatment (packs/resolve.ts): resolves <type>.depth → core depth-treatment (specific→core, ADR-0024) into a typed hard-offset shadow rig consumed in code. Newspaper CanvasSource derives its signature box-shadow from this (dropped hardcoded HARD_OFFSET_SHADOW_PX/#1a1612). VERIFIED LIVE in the running app DOM (chrome-devtools): on the exact <article.newspaper-source> html-in-canvas captures, syntax computes box-shadow '12px 12px 0px #1a1612' (byte-identical, no regression); flipping the preset to editorial-mono (newspaper.depth:'none') computes box-shadow 'none' (flat re-skin) with cool palette applied — temp preset edit reverted. NOTE: the chrome-devtools browser does NOT have chrome://flags/#canvas-draw-element enabled, so the DOM-capture surface does not rasterize to canvas there (canvas shows transparency only); verified at the captured-element CSS layer instead, which is what html-in-canvas rasterizes. Also: svelte-check 0 errors; verify-presets green; resolver unit check (syntax→12px, editorial-mono→null, core-fallback→8px). resolveStyle/resolveRole left dead for lg5zd5w6.

commit.message: Wire structural depth Role to pixels (newspaper hard-offset shadow)
